metaDescription: Domestic Longhair vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Domestic Longhair boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Why timing is non-negotiable for Domestic Longhairs: each booster lands after the previous dose’s immunology window, usually every 2–4 weeks, until the Domestic Longhair series closes at about 16 weeks.
Size class medium does not invent new viruses for the Domestic Longhair, but it does change crate fit, blood-draw ease, and how early you lock travel relative to the final FVRCP booster.
Flag chronic kidney disease (senior) at Domestic Longhair vaccine checkups so the kitten’s chart accumulates breed-relevant context, not just sticker dates.
When the Domestic Longhair series is complete, switch reminders to adult booster cadence instead of deleting the vaccine thread entirely.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: If your Domestic Longhair misses the dose scheduled near week 12, call the clinic the same day with product names — do not restart the Domestic Longhair series from memory.
The danger for a delayed Domestic Longhair is the gap, not the embarrassment, because panleukopenia pressure stays real for an under-vaccinated kitten even in clean-looking neighborhoods.
While waiting for the make-up FVRCP visit, skip high-traffic dog parks / unknown-cat intros and keep the Domestic Longhair away from unvaccinated animals.
After catch-up, rewrite reminders for the next Domestic Longhair due date (7, 3, and 1 day prior) so the same miss does not recur.

faqs.question: When does the Domestic Longhair core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual kitten.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Domestic Longhair misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Domestic Longhair health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Domestic Longhair adult health guide for breed predispositions such as dental disease, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
